# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 114 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 114 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_114_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 10 — The Last Words of the Shepherd

**1** A few days later I saw the Shepherd once more and asked him again about these same things. **2** "I've already told you everything I was sent to say," he told me. "But because you keep asking so earnestly, I'll add one more thing. **3** The message of repentance must go out to God's servants throughout the entire world — for God, out of compassion, has given more time for repentance. **4** God did not send his Son and the glorious angels to watch over ordinary, insignificant people. He sent them to watch over the great and powerful who serve him in righteousness. **5** Proclaim all of this to everyone. And to those who have already repented, speak words of encouragement — don't let them give up under the suffering they're enduring because of the Lord's name. **6** The suffering they're going through is not pointless — it has been specifically appointed for God's servants, so that through it they will be purified and found worthy of the Lord. **7** And say to the church leaders: don't waver in your prayers. The Lord doesn't waver, and he hears every prayer and answers it." **8** "Will he really answer all of them?" I asked. "Yes," he said. "And if an answer is delayed, be patient — the Lord's delay is not indifference. It's patience toward you, because he doesn't want a single one of you to be lost." **9** With those words he left me. And I never saw him again.

---

*PNEUMA renders the Shepherd's final words as a pastoral farewell — the long-suffering God waiting for none to be lost, and then the quiet, final ending: "I never saw him again."*
